title: Pocketwire Rewards Membership Anniversary Bonus: Entitlement and Crediting Tool
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards anniversary bonus is owed for each anniversary of the enrolment date reached while the membership is active, and it is booked as one entry for that anniversary year, carrying the year of the anniversary as its period.

## Entitlement

1. The anniversary bonus is owed for each anniversary of the enrolment date reached while the membership is active.
2. It is booked as one entry for that anniversary year, carrying the year of the anniversary as its period.
3. An anniversary bonus is credited only if the ledger carries no anniversary bonus entry dated on or after the most recent anniversary of the enrolment date.
4. Bonus points are subject to the tier's pending period like any other earning.

## Hypothetical case

A membership enrolled on 12 March 2021 is handled on 20 March 2025, and has been active throughout. The most recent anniversary of the enrolment date is 12 March 2025.

| Latest anniversary bonus entry on the ledger | Dated on or after 12 March 2025 | Anniversary bonus for 2025 can be credited |
|---|---|---|
| dated 13 March 2024, period 2024 | No | Yes, with period 2025 |
| dated 12 March 2025, period 2025 | Yes | No |
| none | No | Yes, with period 2025 |

## Crediting tool: credit_anniversary_bonus_4deaf7db

Situation of use and capability. The tool credits a Pocketwire Rewards membership anniversary bonus to a member's points balance. It books one anniversary bonus entry on the member's points ledger, dated today, for the anniversary year given, and adds the points to the membership's points balance. The member sees the bonus in the app's points activity and a higher points balance straight away.

How it is invoked. `credit_anniversary_bonus_4deaf7db` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

Parameters.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the rewards membership reference number of the member being credited, as returned by the rewards membership lookup | reference number |
| `bonus_period` | the period the bonus is for; this tool books anniversary bonuses only, so it is the four-digit calendar year in which the anniversary fell | YYYY |
| `points` | the bonus points credited | a whole integer number of points, zero or positive |

Return. A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the text "credited" when the entry was booked), `rewards_entry_id` (reference number of the new points entry), `membership_id` (the membership credited), `bonus_type` (always the text "anniversary"), `bonus_period` (as booked), `points` (integer points credited), `entry_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (the membership's integer points balance including this credit).

Illustration (hypothetical input). A call with `bonus_period` 2025 and `points` 1200 returns `status` "credited", `bonus_type` "anniversary", `bonus_period` 2025, `points` 1200, today's `entry_date` and the balance raised by 1200 points.
